hero.title: Confirm it, print the label, hand it over.
hero.description: When an order comes in, confirm it and tap Fulfill Order. Qlozet books the courier your customer chose and gives you a label to print. The courier collects from your address.

quotes.title: Customers choose the courier, and pay for it
quotes.description: At checkout, shoppers see live prices from couriers for the trip from your address to theirs, and pick the one that suits them. Delivery is paid by the customer, never by you.
points: Real quotes, not flat zone fees
Each store in a cart quoted on its own

updates.title: Every scan updates the order for you
updates.description: Once the courier has it, their scans move the order along: shipped, in transit, delivered. Your customer gets a notification and an email at each step. You don't mark anything by hand.
points: Customers told when it's out for delivery

shipby.title: A clear date on every order
shipby.description: Each order shows when it needs to ship, from the making time you set on the product. Shipping late takes 5% of the items a day from your earnings, up to 25%, and it goes to the customer.
points: Confirm within 24 hours of the order
Clocks pause while you wait on the customer
A reminder before the date comes

closing.title: Spend your time on the making.
closing.description: Labels, couriers and customer updates are handled. You confirm, print and pack.
